from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fixed_score_price_response_timing_v1'
STUDY='510300_FIXED_SCORE_PRICE_RESPONSE_TIMING_V1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
parents=[
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/next_experiment.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/保存结果必要核对.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错十变量历史输入及原标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错10变量每日联合评分.csv',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/固定高分不重叠机会.csv',
'data/reference/510300_dividends.csv',
'research/multidim_nonlinear_score_v1.py',
'research/multidim_policy_transmission_score_v1.py']
for rel in parents:
    if not (ROOT/rel).is_file():raise FileNotFoundError(rel)
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
target=OUT/'protocol.json'
assert not target.exists(),'协议已存在，禁止覆盖。'
protocol={'study_id':STUDY,'experiment_id':'E22','recorded_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'status':'REGISTERED_FIXED_HISTORICAL_PRICE_RESPONSE_TIMING_DIAGNOSTIC',
'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E20_SOURCE_VERSION_GAP_AND_E21_CONFIRMED_INPUT_ERROR_CORRECTION_COMPLETED',
'question':'原高分无后续净收益，是否主要表现为信号形成前已上涨、买入后缺乏收益？',
'research_scope':'指数历史解释；原E21保存评分及自然机会，不产生新交易候选。',
'primary_period':['2024-01-01','2025-12-31'],'earlier_context':['2021-01-01','2023-12-31'],
'score_pool':{'each_model':1212,'primary':485,'earlier':727,'feature_sets':[8,10],'existing_five_bands':['0—20','20—40','40—60','60—80','80—100']},
'opportunity_pool':'只复用E21固定score>=80且预测>0的非重叠机会；主期两模型各9笔，保留全部记录，不改阈值、方向或持有。',
'definitions':{
'pre20_total_return':'wealth[i]/wealth[i-20]-1，原指数趋势分子，包含信号日；不是20日前即可知道的预测。',
'pre19_before_signal_total_return':'wealth[i-1]/wealth[i-20]-1，仅作与信号日的复利恒等式分解，非另选19日窗口。',
'signal_day_total_return':'直接复用原total_simple[i]；不能加到已经包含它的pre20。',
'raw_next_open_quote_gap':'open[i+1]/close[i]-1，只有次日开盘后实际可观察，不能作为原16点信号输入。',
'dividend_aligned_next_open_gap':'(open[i+1]+dividend[i+1])/close[i]-1，与原overnight_log[i+1]复算；为既有持有人除息对齐的价格段，不声称次日新买者有此权益或可赚该缺口。',
'executable_net5':'只复用E21 actual_net5/net_label，次日开盘入/第5交易日开盘出，原10000股权益及成本不变；不计算新的持有期标签。',
'ranking_prediction':'直接复用E21分数/树预测，不重新拟合。'},
'display':'两模型、两个原时期的全部五档均保留；逐笔列出全部自然机会及上述分段，每期仅描述均值/中位数/符号计数。',
'fixed_interpretation_rule':'若主期自然高分机会pre20平均为正且原net5平均非正，只接受该固定池中的先涨后无净收益事实；否则不接受该简单叙述。无论哪项，都不凭时间先后证明完全信息吸收、机制因果或提前成交优势。',
'inference_limits':'五日标签重叠，九笔机会少且日期集中；历史已观察。不开显著性扫描，不追加分组或找最佳窗口/退出；不利用未来峰值。',
'anti_overfit':'只固定算术诊断，不改变模型、特征、成本、账户、阈值、年份或原拒绝；负收益不反向交易。',
'new_source_acquisitions':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'parameter_grids':0,'source_code_edits':0,
'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False,
'parents':[{'path':r,'bytes':(ROOT/r).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(ROOT/r)} for r in parents]}
target.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E22登记':'完成','父文件':len(parents),'评分日每模型':1212,'主期固定机会每模型':9,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'源码修改':0},ensure_ascii=False))
